turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Monday to Friday are usually shipped out on the same day.
As soon as your order ships, you will receive an email containing your tracking link.

Regarding delivery times, once your order is shipped:

Deliveries within Germany typically take about 5 business days.
For all other supported countries in Europe, the delivery time is generally 5-10 business days.

Please keep in mind that no deliveries are made on Sundays or public holidays.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
That's a very understandable question. It can be concerning when you don't see updates on your tracking.

For international shipments—meaning any orders shipping outside of Germany—it's not uncommon for the tracking to take a little while to show new updates. It can sometimes take 7-10 business days for the tracking information to refresh as the package moves between carriers.

I hope this information helps provide some peace of mind! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
